1 | Profitability marked a turning point and improved healthy margin expansion in JD Retail and narrowed losses in JD Food Delivery.

Most notably, Q2 marked a definitive turning point for our profitability trajectory. Our non-GAAP net income attributable to ordinary shareholders surged by 21% year-on-year to RMB 8.9 billion, driven by both JD Retail's healthy margin expansion and JD Food Delivery's loss reduction. In particular, both JD Retail gross margin and operating margin hit historic highs for peak promotional seasons, and JD Food Delivery narrowed its losses by over 50% year-on-year in the quarter. This performance underscores the unique strength of our business model.

2 | Food delivery maintained healthy order volume while narrowing total losses by 50% YoY.

During the second quarter, JD Food Delivery maintained healthy order volume momentum while narrowing total losses by over 50% year-on-year. Within just 1 year of execution, JD Food Delivery has achieved a dramatic fast-paced improvement in unit economics, driven by our relentless focus to drive operational efficiency and revenue diversification. Moving forward, we see substantial runway for further UE optimization in our Food Delivery business, while we continue to unlock its cross-segment synergies with our core retail business.

3 | JD Retail revenues declined -5% in Q2 due to tough comps from electronics and home appliances trade-in program

Second, core JD Retail delivered a resilient top line performance in Q2, while continuing to unlock profitability upside. Heading into Q3, we expect JD Retail to hit a turning point, reaccelerating into positive top line expansion while sustaining healthy bottom line.

Looking at category performance, while revenues from electronics and home appliances were moderated by a high comparison base and upstream price increase in Q2, but momentum picked up in June.

4 | Expect Q3 to reaccelerate growth with sustained healthy profitability, as tough comps ease and normalize.

Looking into the second half, while the ongoing rising consumer electronic price may continue to weigh on consumer demand, we remain confident that this category growth will improve meaningfully in the second half for three reasons: Number one, the base effect start to gradually normalize. Starting from Q3, the drag from last year high trading base will gradually ease. Growth in electronics and home appliance is expected to reaccelerate as comparison base normalize.

5 | JD Retail’s 3P GMV growth continued to be faster than 1P for the past 3 consecutive quarters. Expect JD Retail’ growth to accelerate in H2

We continue to onboard high-quality merchants and incubating emerging brands while helping them optimize end-to-end operations. This allows merchants and brands to achieve more certain growth on JD while also bringing incremental sales to our platform at the same time. JD Retail's 3P GMV growth has outpaced 1P for the past 3 consecutive quarters with its contribution to total GMV expanding Q-on-Q in Q2. So overall, we expect JD Retail's growth to accelerate quarter-by-quarter in the second half of the year. Our electronics and home appliance should steadily recover while general merchandise category maintained healthy growth.

6 | Unique economics for JD food delivery improved meaningfully, driven by refined operations and higher subsidy efficiency, as subsidy per order decreased significantly.

JD Food Delivery has made solid progress in the second quarter, order volume maintained healthy growth while narrowing total loss by over 50% YoY. So within just 1 year of execution, the unit economics improved meaningfully for this business, driven by refined operations and higher subsidy efficiency. We saw subsidy per order notably decreased year-on-year, enhanced delivery efficiency at scale and growing contribution from commissions and advertising revenues.

7 | Supermarkets remain a key standout, delivering near double-digit revenue growth.

In particular, our supermarket category remained a key standout, delivering near double-digit year-on-year revenue growth. With a proven multiyear track record, JD Supermarket has established itself as the most trusted platform for both users and suppliers. This success is a powerful example demonstrating how our core philosophy, the relentless pursuit of superior user experience, cost optimization and operational efficiency translates into sustainable market leadership.

8 | Faster growing and higher margin marketplace and marketing revenues will outpace product sales, driving further margin expansion over time.

Within this line, marketplace and marketing revenues were up 8.3%, primarily driven by higher growth in advertising revenues. Although growth moderated relatively to previous quarters against a high user traffic base, marketplace and marketing revenues consistently outpaced the product sales. We expect this structural divergence to continue, serving as an important driver for our margin expansion over time. Logistics and other service revenues increased by 5.9% year-on-year in the quarter. The pace normalized as our food delivery business lapped its initial launch and entered a full comparable year-on-year period starting this quarter.

9 | Improved profitability was primarily driven by JD Retail with lower OPEX, with optimized marketing spend, versus slightly higher R&D with respect to AI.

Turning to our consolidated profit performance. Group level gross margin expanded meaningfully by 120bps YoY to 17.1% in Q2, reaching a near all-time high. This expansion was primarily driven by JD Retail's remarkable margin performance. On operating expense, total operating expense decreased by 4.4% YoY in the quarter with the expense ratio decreasing by 0.3 percentage points. This operating leverage was largely driven by optimized marketing spend, which was partially offset by stepped-up R&D investments, particularly scalable AI applications. This leaner OpEx structure reflects our strategic focus on operational efficiency and bottom line quality over low ROI volume expansion.

10 | Saw good progress with  Joybuy in Europe and Jingxi.

Operations at our Joybuy and Jingxi businesses advanced steadily along their strategic path with strict ROI discipline. During the quarter, Joybuy sharpened its competitive edge in Europe through its fast, reliable fulfillment and premium localized services, such as integrated delivery and installation service for home appliances. By directly addressing local consumers' pain points, Joybuy is building increasing user retention and has doubled its revenues within 2 quarters. Jingxi continued to deepen its penetration in lower-tier markets with QAC increasing over 40% year-on-year and contributing 40% of new active customers in Q2, unlocking valuable incremental user pools for our ecosystem. While both businesses saw a sequential step-up in strategic investment, all spend was executed with rigorous discipline and strictly within our expectations.

11 | Joybuy now offers same-day and next-day delivery across major European cities, powered up by its own warehouse network in Europe.

First, Joybuy is starting to establish a clear edge in user experience and retention, powered by our own warehouse network in Europe. Joybuy now offers same-day and next-day delivery across major European cities, bringing 'place order in the morning, receive in the afternoon' hyperfast delivery services to over 40 million customers in Europe.

12 | JDL scaled thousands of unmanned ground features and launched their first 24 x 7 overnight autonomous delivery routes in Shenzhen.

On the logistics automation, our progress in physical logistics automation gives us substantial headroom to further optimize our cost structure and operating efficiency. In warehousing and sorting, JD through JD Logistics expanded deployment of our proprietary LangzuTech Goods-to-Person solution across more warehouses and product categories. In autonomous delivery, JDL scaled thousands of unmanned ground vehicles across more than 20 provinces as of Q2. We are launching our first 24/7 overnight autonomous delivery routes in Shenzhen. Powering this automation is our Jingdong Logistics MetaBrain LLM, which drives real-time intelligent decision-making within our exclusive automated operating framework.

13 | 2Q26 marks the clear inflection of its profitability, with margins to improve, and growth to reaccelerate in 2H26.

On JD Group's profitability, Q2 marked a clear inflection in its trajectory, returning to healthy year-on-year expansion. Looking ahead to the second half of the year, supported by core business health and investment discipline, we are confident in driving accelerated profit growth at the group level. Over the long term, as our core retail business has further room to enhance profitability and new businesses continue to optimize ROI efficiency, unlock synergies and gradually become new growth engines, we are well positioned to drive steady long-term profit expansion for the group.

➡️ Final Takeaways on https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK $JD: 

While topline revenue growth was negative due to tougher comps in electronics and home applications, 3P, general merchandise, supermarket, advertising and logistics remained strong. Revenues should reaccelerate in H2 as tough comps ease. Food delivery continued to narrow losses and is moving in the right direction. Higher margin advertising, 3P, strong operating leverage should drive further profit margin expansion in the years ahead.

1 | 盈利能力出现转折点，并推动 JD Retail 健康的利润率扩张，同时 JD Food Delivery 亏损收窄。

最值得注意的是，第二季度标志着我们盈利轨迹的明确转折点。受 JD Retail 健康的利润率扩张和 JD Food Delivery 减亏的推动，我们归属于普通股股东的非公认会计准则净利润同比大增 21%，达到人民币 8.9 billion。特别是，JD Retail 的毛利率和经营利润率均创下促销旺季历史新高，JD Food Delivery 在该季度的亏损同比收窄超过 50%。这一表现凸显了我们商业模式的独特优势。

2 | 外卖在总亏损同比收窄 50% 的同时，保持了健康的订单量。

第二季度，JD Food Delivery 在保持健康订单量势头的同时，总亏损同比收窄超过 50%。在仅仅 1 年的执行时间里，JD Food Delivery 的单位经济效益实现了快速而显著的改善，这得益于我们坚持不懈地专注于提升运营效率和收入多元化。展望未来，我们认为外卖业务在进一步优化 UE 方面仍有巨大空间，同时我们将继续释放其与核心零售业务的跨板块协同效应。

3 | 由于电子产品和家用电器以旧换新计划的高基数对比，JD Retail 第二季度收入下降 -5%

其次，核心 JD Retail 在第二季度实现了有韧性的营收表现，同时继续释放盈利上行空间。进入第三季度，我们预计 JD Retail 将迎来转折点，重新加速实现营收正增长，同时保持健康的利润水平。

从品类表现来看，尽管电子产品和家用电器收入在第二季度受到高比较基数和上游价格上涨的影响而放缓，但势头在 6 月有所回升。

4 | 随着高基数对比压力缓解并正常化，预计第三季度增长将重新加速，同时保持健康的盈利能力。

展望下半年，尽管消费电子产品价格持续上涨可能会继续压制消费者需求，但我们仍有信心，出于三个原因，该品类的增长将在下半年显著改善：第一，基数效应开始逐步正常化。从第三季度开始，去年高交易基数带来的拖累将逐渐缓解。随着比较基数正常化，电子产品和家电的增长预计将重新加速。

5 | JD Retail 的 3P GMV 增长在过去连续 3 个季度持续快于 1P。预计 JD Retail 在下半年的增长将加速

我们继续引入高质量商家并孵化新兴品牌，同时帮助他们优化端到端运营。这使商家和品牌能够在 JD 上实现更确定的增长，同时也为我们的平台带来增量销售。JD Retail 的 3P GMV 增长在过去连续 3 个季度超过 1P，其对总 GMV 的贡献在第二季度环比扩大。因此总体而言，我们预计 JD Retail 的增长将在今年下半年逐季加速。我们的电子产品和家电应会稳步恢复，而日用百货品类保持健康增长。

6 | 在精细化运营和更高补贴效率的推动下，JD Food Delivery 的单位经济效益显著改善，每单补贴大幅下降。

JD Food Delivery 在第二季度取得了扎实进展，订单量保持健康增长，同时总亏损同比收窄超过 50%。因此，在仅仅 1 年的执行过程中，该业务的单位经济效益显著改善，这得益于精细化运营和更高的补贴效率。我们看到每单补贴同比明显下降，规模化下配送效率提升，以及佣金和广告收入贡献增加。

7 | 超市仍是一个关键亮点，实现了接近两位数的收入增长。

尤其是，我们的超市品类仍是一个关键亮点，实现了接近两位数的同比收入增长。凭借多年经验证的业绩记录，JD Supermarket 已确立其作为用户和供应商最值得信赖平台的地位。这一成功是一个有力例证，展示了我们的核心理念——不懈追求卓越用户体验、成本优化和运营效率——如何转化为可持续的市场领导地位。

8 | 增长更快、利润率更高的市场平台和营销收入将超过产品销售，推动利润率随时间进一步扩张。

在这一项下，市场平台和营销收入增长 8.3%，主要受广告收入更高增长推动。尽管在高用户流量基数下，增长相较前几个季度有所放缓，但市场平台和营销收入持续超过产品销售。我们预计这种结构性分化将继续，成为我们利润率随时间扩张的重要驱动力。本季度物流及其他服务收入同比增长 5.9%。随着我们的外卖业务已度过初始上线阶段，并从本季度开始进入完整的同比可比周期，增长节奏恢复正常。

9 | 盈利能力改善主要由 JD Retail 推动，其 OPEX 较低，营销支出得到优化，而与 AI 相关的研发支出略高。

转向我们的合并利润表现。集团层面的毛利率在第二季度同比显著扩大120个基点至17.1%，接近历史最高水平。这一扩张主要由 JD Retail 出色的利润率表现推动。在运营费用方面，本季度总运营费用同比下降4.4%，费用率下降0.3个百分点。这种经营杠杆主要由优化后的营销支出驱动，但部分被增加的研发投资所抵消，尤其是可扩展的 AI 应用。这种更精简的运营费用结构反映了我们在战略上专注于运营效率和利润质量，而非低 ROI 的规模扩张。

10 | Joybuy 在欧洲和 Jingxi 取得了良好进展。

我们的 Joybuy 和 Jingxi 业务在严格的 ROI 纪律下，沿着各自的战略路径稳步推进。本季度，Joybuy 通过快速、可靠的履约和优质本地化服务，在欧洲强化了竞争优势，例如为家电提供一体化配送和安装服务。通过直接解决当地消费者的痛点，Joybuy 正在提升用户留存，并在2个季度内实现收入翻倍。Jingxi 继续深化在低线市场的渗透，QAC 同比增长超过40%，并在第二季度贡献了40%的新活跃客户，为我们的生态系统释放了有价值的增量用户池。尽管这两项业务的战略投资均环比增加，但所有支出都以严格纪律执行，并严格符合我们的预期。

11 | Joybuy 现在依托其在欧洲自有的仓储网络，在欧洲主要城市提供当日达和次日达服务。

首先，依托我们在欧洲自有的仓储网络，Joybuy 正在用户体验和留存方面建立明确优势。Joybuy 现在在欧洲主要城市提供当日达和次日达服务，为欧洲超过4000万客户带来“上午下单，下午收到”的超快速配送服务。

在物流自动化方面，我们在实体物流自动化方面的进展为我们进一步优化成本结构和运营效率提供了巨大空间。在仓储和分拣方面，JD 通过 JD Logistics 将我们自有的 LangzuTech Goods-to-Person 解决方案扩展部署到更多仓库和产品类别。在自动驾驶配送方面，截至第二季度，JDL 已在20多个省份部署了数千辆无人地面车辆。我们正在深圳推出首批24/7夜间自动驾驶配送路线。为这一自动化提供动力的是我们的 Jingdong Logistics MetaBrain LLM，它在我们专属的自动化运营框架内推动实时智能决策。

13 | 2Q26 标志着其盈利能力出现明确拐点，利润率将改善，增长将在2H26重新加速。

关于 JD Group 的盈利能力，Q2 标志着其发展轨迹出现明确拐点，恢复到健康的同比扩张。展望今年下半年，在核心业务健康和投资纪律的支持下，我们有信心推动集团层面的利润增长加速。长期来看，随着我们的核心零售业务仍有进一步提升盈利能力的空间，新业务持续优化 ROI 效率、释放协同效应并逐步成为新的增长引擎，我们处于有利位置，能够推动集团利润实现稳定的长期扩张。

Seit 1. Juli 2026 führt Remko Rijnders (48) offiziell die Geschicke der Ceconomy AG. Der gebürtige Niederländer ist kein Unbekannter im Konzern – er blickt auf eine 18-jährige Karriere bei MediaMarktSaturn zurück.

Jährlich bis zu fünf neue „Express“-Märkte
Ein zentraler Pfeiler von Rijnders‘ Zukunftsplan für Österreich (2400 Mitarbeiter, 56 Standorte und zuletzt über 1,3 Milliarden Euro Umsatz) ist die Expansion mit kleinen Filialen: „Meine Erwartung ist, dass wir in den nächsten Jahren vier bis fünf neue Express-Stores pro Jahr eröffnen.“

Rijnders betont, dass diese Standorte nicht als Konkurrenz zum großen Sortiment gedacht sind, sondern eine Brücke zum Online-Geschäft schlagen: „Indem wir kleine Stores eröffnen, steigt auch der Online-Umsatz.“ Grund dafür sei das Vertrauen der Kunden, die bei Problemen bei Internetbestellungen einen Ansprechpartner in der Nähe wollen.

Mehr Tempo an der Kasse – aber der Mensch bleibt
Für Aufregung sorgte zuletzt die Ankündigung, die klassischen Kassen abzuschaffen. Rijnders stellt klar: „Ich bin fest davon überzeugt, dass wir immer besetzte Kassen haben werden.“ Der Self-Checkout, ähnlich wie bei Billa oder Ikea, solle lediglich eine zusätzliche Option für Kunden sein, die es besonders eilig haben. Es gehe nicht um Kosteneinsparungen: „Wir machen es, weil viele Kunden es einfordern.“ Getestet wird das System derzeit in Italien. Ein flächendeckender Rollout in Österreich ist frühestens für Ende 2027 geplant.

Die JD.com-Übernahme: Schneller, günstiger, innovativer?
Der größte Paukenschlag ist aber die geplante Übernahme der Ceconomy durch den chinesischen Online-Riesen JD.com Rijnders erwartet den Vollzug „vor dem 10. November“ – möglicherweise bereits Ende September oder Anfang Oktober.
Für die österreichischen Kunden ergeben sich laut dem Ceconomy-Chef daraus klare Vorteile:

Schnellere Lieferungen durch Logistik-Power: Rijnders verspricht, dass die Kombination der über 1000 europäischen Filialen mit der Logistik-Expertise von JD.com die Liefergeschwindigkeit drastisch erhöhen wird. Das ambitionierte Ziel für Österreich: „Heute bestellt, morgen geliefert.“
Potenziell niedrigere Preise: Durch die gebündelte Einkaufsmacht mit JD.com will MediaMarkt bessere Konditionen bei Herstellern durchsetzen. Diese Kostenvorteile will man an die Kunden weitergeben.
Mehr Technologie und Innovation: JD.com bringt Know-how im Bereich E-Commerce und Datenanalyse mit, das zu einer besseren Personalisierung des Angebots führen soll.

电子产品巨头 #MediaMarkt 目前热闹不断：德国母公司 Ceconomy 的新任负责人 Remko Rijnders 计划在奥地利发起一轮小型门店扩张，并将在未来采用自助收银台。此外，中国在线巨头 JD.com 对其的收购也即将完成。这对奥地利消费者意味着什么。

自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起，Remko Rijnders（48岁）正式掌舵 Ceconomy AG。这位出生于荷兰的高管在集团内并非陌生人——他在 MediaMarktSaturn 已有 18 年的职业经历。

每年最多新增五家“Express”门店
Rijnders 针对奥地利（2400 名员工、56 个网点，最近营收超过 13 亿欧元）的未来计划中，一个核心支柱是通过小型门店进行扩张：“我的预期是，未来几年我们每年会开设四到五家新的 Express Stores。”
这些所谓的 Smart Stores 或 Express Stores 的销售面积不到 600 平方米，比传统门店（2500 至 3000 平方米）紧凑得多。目前奥地利已经有七家这样的迷你门店，例如位于 Tulln、Gmunden、Fürstenfeld 和 Wolfsberg。

Rijnders 强调，这些网点并不是要与大型商品组合竞争，而是要架起通往线上业务的桥梁：“通过开设小型门店，线上销售额也会上升。”原因是客户的信任——他们希望在网上下单遇到问题时，附近能有联系人可找。

收银速度更快——但人仍然保留
最近，引发热议的是取消传统收银台的公告。Rijnders 澄清说：“我坚信，我们永远都会有 staffed 收银台。”类似于 Billa 或 Ikea 的自助结账，只是为特别赶时间的客户提供一个额外选项。这并不是为了节省成本：“我们这样做，是因为许多客户有这样的要求。”该系统目前正在意大利测试。在奥地利全面 rollout 最早计划于 2027 年底进行。

JD.com 收购：更快、更便宜、更具创新性？
但最大的重磅消息是中国在线巨头 JD.com 计划收购 Ceconomy。Rijnders 预计交易将在“11 月 10 日之前”完成——可能早在 9 月底或 10 月初。
据这位 Ceconomy 负责人称，奥地利客户将由此获得明确的好处：

借助物流实力实现更快配送：Rijnders 承诺，将欧洲超过 1000 家门店与 JD.com 的物流专业能力结合起来，将大幅提升配送速度。奥地利的雄心目标是：“今天下单，明天送达。”
潜在的更低价格：通过与 JD.com 联合形成的采购实力，MediaMarkt 希望在制造商那里争取到更好的条件。这些成本优势将转嫁给客户。
更多技术和创新：JD.com 带来了电子商务和数据分析领域的专业知识，这应有助于实现更好的商品推荐个性化。

1 | Profitability marked a turning point and improved healthy margin expansion in JD Retail and narrowed losses in JD Food Delivery.

Most notably, Q2 marked a definitive turning point for our profitability trajectory. Our non-GAAP net income attributable to ordinary shareholders surged by 21% year-on-year to RMB 8.9 billion, driven by both JD Retail's healthy margin expansion and JD Food Delivery's loss reduction. In particular, both JD Retail gross margin and operating margin hit historic highs for peak promotional seasons, and JD Food Delivery narrowed its losses by over 50% year-on-year in the quarter. This performance underscores the unique strength of our business model.

2 | Food delivery maintained healthy order volume while narrowing total losses by 50% YoY.

During the second quarter, JD Food Delivery maintained healthy order volume momentum while narrowing total losses by over 50% year-on-year. Within just 1 year of execution, JD Food Delivery has achieved a dramatic fast-paced improvement in unit economics, driven by our relentless focus to drive operational efficiency and revenue diversification. Moving forward, we see substantial runway for further UE optimization in our Food Delivery business, while we continue to unlock its cross-segment synergies with our core retail business.

3 | JD Retail revenues declined -5% in Q2 due to tough comps from electronics and home appliances trade-in program

Second, core JD Retail delivered a resilient top line performance in Q2, while continuing to unlock profitability upside. Heading into Q3, we expect JD Retail to hit a turning point, reaccelerating into positive top line expansion while sustaining healthy bottom line.

Looking at category performance, while revenues from electronics and home appliances were moderated by a high comparison base and upstream price increase in Q2, but momentum picked up in June.

4 | Expect Q3 to reaccelerate growth with sustained healthy profitability, as tough comps ease and normalize.

Looking into the second half, while the ongoing rising consumer electronic price may continue to weigh on consumer demand, we remain confident that this category growth will improve meaningfully in the second half for three reasons: Number one, the base effect start to gradually normalize. Starting from Q3, the drag from last year high trading base will gradually ease. Growth in electronics and home appliance is expected to reaccelerate as comparison base normalize.

5 | JD Retail’s 3P GMV growth continued to be faster than 1P for the past 3 consecutive quarters. Expect JD Retail’ growth to accelerate in H2

We continue to onboard high-quality merchants and incubating emerging brands while helping them optimize end-to-end operations. This allows merchants and brands to achieve more certain growth on JD while also bringing incremental sales to our platform at the same time. JD Retail's 3P GMV growth has outpaced 1P for the past 3 consecutive quarters with its contribution to total GMV expanding Q-on-Q in Q2. So overall, we expect JD Retail's growth to accelerate quarter-by-quarter in the second half of the year. Our electronics and home appliance should steadily recover while general merchandise category maintained healthy growth.

6 | Unique economics for JD food delivery improved meaningfully, driven by refined operations and higher subsidy efficiency, as subsidy per order decreased significantly.

JD Food Delivery has made solid progress in the second quarter, order volume maintained healthy growth while narrowing total loss by over 50% YoY. So within just 1 year of execution, the unit economics improved meaningfully for this business, driven by refined operations and higher subsidy efficiency. We saw subsidy per order notably decreased year-on-year, enhanced delivery efficiency at scale and growing contribution from commissions and advertising revenues.

7 | Supermarkets remain a key standout, delivering near double-digit revenue growth.

In particular, our supermarket category remained a key standout, delivering near double-digit year-on-year revenue growth. With a proven multiyear track record, JD Supermarket has established itself as the most trusted platform for both users and suppliers. This success is a powerful example demonstrating how our core philosophy, the relentless pursuit of superior user experience, cost optimization and operational efficiency translates into sustainable market leadership.

8 | Faster growing and higher margin marketplace and marketing revenues will outpace product sales, driving further margin expansion over time.

Within this line, marketplace and marketing revenues were up 8.3%, primarily driven by higher growth in advertising revenues. Although growth moderated relatively to previous quarters against a high user traffic base, marketplace and marketing revenues consistently outpaced the product sales. We expect this structural divergence to continue, serving as an important driver for our margin expansion over time. Logistics and other service revenues increased by 5.9% year-on-year in the quarter. The pace normalized as our food delivery business lapped its initial launch and entered a full comparable year-on-year period starting this quarter.

9 | Improved profitability was primarily driven by JD Retail with lower OPEX, with optimized marketing spend, versus slightly higher R&D with respect to AI.

Turning to our consolidated profit performance. Group level gross margin expanded meaningfully by 120bps YoY to 17.1% in Q2, reaching a near all-time high. This expansion was primarily driven by JD Retail's remarkable margin performance. On operating expense, total operating expense decreased by 4.4% YoY in the quarter with the expense ratio decreasing by 0.3 percentage points. This operating leverage was largely driven by optimized marketing spend, which was partially offset by stepped-up R&D investments, particularly scalable AI applications. This leaner OpEx structure reflects our strategic focus on operational efficiency and bottom line quality over low ROI volume expansion.

10 | Saw good progress with Joybuy in Europe and Jingxi.

Operations at our Joybuy and Jingxi businesses advanced steadily along their strategic path with strict ROI discipline. During the quarter, Joybuy sharpened its competitive edge in Europe through its fast, reliable fulfillment and premium localized services, such as integrated delivery and installation service for home appliances. By directly addressing local consumers' pain points, Joybuy is building increasing user retention and has doubled its revenues within 2 quarters. Jingxi continued to deepen its penetration in lower-tier markets with QAC increasing over 40% year-on-year and contributing 40% of new active customers in Q2, unlocking valuable incremental user pools for our ecosystem. While both businesses saw a sequential step-up in strategic investment, all spend was executed with rigorous discipline and strictly within our expectations.

https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK 2Q26 Earnings
- Rev ¥346.4b -3% ↘️🔴
- GP ¥59.3b +5% ↗️🟡 margin 17.1% +124 bps ✅
- Adj EBITDA ¥7.9b +165% ⤴️🟢 margin 2.3% +145 bps ✅
- EBIT ¥5.9b +426% ⤴️🟢 margin 1.7% +139 bps ✅
- NG Net Inc ¥8.9b +21% ↗️🟢 margin 2.6% +50 bps ✅
- Net Inc ¥8.7b +29% ↗️🟢 margin 2.5% +63 bps ✅
- OCF ¥37.7b +55% ↗️🟢 margin 10.9% +404 bps ✅
- FCF ¥31.8b +45% ↗️🟢 margin 9.2% +302 bps ✅

Revenue by Segment
- Net product revenues ¥511.9b -2% ↘️🔴
- Electronics and home appliances revenues ¥290.1b -10% ↘️🔴
- General merchandise revenues ¥221.9b +10% ↗️🟡
- Net service revenues ¥150.2b +13% ↗️🟡
- Marketplace and marketing revenues ¥57.4b +13% ↗️🟡
- Logistics and other service revenues ¥92.8b +13% ↗️🟡

JD Retail
- Rev ¥295.4b -5% ↘️🔴
- GP ¥54.7b +2% ➡️🟠 margin 19% +126 bps ✅
- EBIT ¥13.5b -3.3% ↘️🔴 margin 4.6% +7 bps ✅

JD Logistics
- Rev ¥64.1b +24% ↗️🟢
- GP ¥6.1b +15% ↗️🟡 margin 10% -80 bps ✅
- EBIT ¥2.3b +15.6% ↗️🟢 margin 3.5% -27 bps ✅

New Businesses
- Rev ¥7.3b -48% ↘️🔴
- GP ¥2.3b ⤴️🟢 margin 32% +3635 bps ✅
- EBIT -¥10.3b ⤴️🟢 margin -141% -3300 bps ✅

1 | Profitability marked a turning point and improved healthy margin expansion in JD Retail and narrowed losses in JD Food Delivery.

Most notably, Q2 marked a definitive turning point for our profitability trajectory. Our non-GAAP net income attributable to ordinary shareholders surged by 21% year-on-year to RMB 8.9 billion, driven by both JD Retail's healthy margin expansion and JD Food Delivery's loss reduction. In particular, both JD Retail gross margin and operating margin hit historic highs for peak promotional seasons, and JD Food Delivery narrowed its losses by over 50% year-on-year in the quarter. This performance underscores the unique strength of our business model.

2 | Food delivery maintained healthy order volume while narrowing total losses by 50% YoY.

During the second quarter, JD Food Delivery maintained healthy order volume momentum while narrowing total losses by over 50% year-on-year. Within just 1 year of execution, JD Food Delivery has achieved a dramatic fast-paced improvement in unit economics, driven by our relentless focus to drive operational efficiency and revenue diversification. Moving forward, we see substantial runway for further UE optimization in our Food Delivery business, while we continue to unlock its cross-segment synergies with our core retail business.

3 | JD Retail revenues declined -5% in Q2 due to tough comps from electronics and home appliances trade-in program

Second, core JD Retail delivered a resilient top line performance in Q2, while continuing to unlock profitability upside. Heading into Q3, we expect JD Retail to hit a turning point, reaccelerating into positive top line expansion while sustaining healthy bottom line.

Looking at category performance, while revenues from electronics and home appliances were moderated by a high comparison base and upstream price increase in Q2, but momentum picked up in June.

4 | Expect Q3 to reaccelerate growth with sustained healthy profitability, as tough comps ease and normalize.

Looking into the second half, while the ongoing rising consumer electronic price may continue to weigh on consumer demand, we remain confident that this category growth will improve meaningfully in the second half for three reasons: Number one, the base effect start to gradually normalize. Starting from Q3, the drag from last year high trading base will gradually ease. Growth in electronics and home appliance is expected to reaccelerate as comparison base normalize.

5 | JD Retail’s 3P GMV growth continued to be faster than 1P for the past 3 consecutive quarters. Expect JD Retail’ growth to accelerate in H2

We continue to onboard high-quality merchants and incubating emerging brands while helping them optimize end-to-end operations. This allows merchants and brands to achieve more certain growth on JD while also bringing incremental sales to our platform at the same time. JD Retail's 3P GMV growth has outpaced 1P for the past 3 consecutive quarters with its contribution to total GMV expanding Q-on-Q in Q2. So overall, we expect JD Retail's growth to accelerate quarter-by-quarter in the second half of the year. Our electronics and home appliance should steadily recover while general merchandise category maintained healthy growth.

6 | Unique economics for JD food delivery improved meaningfully, driven by refined operations and higher subsidy efficiency, as subsidy per order decreased significantly.

JD Food Delivery has made solid progress in the second quarter, order volume maintained healthy growth while narrowing total loss by over 50% YoY. So within just 1 year of execution, the unit economics improved meaningfully for this business, driven by refined operations and higher subsidy efficiency. We saw subsidy per order notably decreased year-on-year, enhanced delivery efficiency at scale and growing contribution from commissions and advertising revenues.

7 | Supermarkets remain a key standout, delivering near double-digit revenue growth.

In particular, our supermarket category remained a key standout, delivering near double-digit year-on-year revenue growth. With a proven multiyear track record, JD Supermarket has established itself as the most trusted platform for both users and suppliers. This success is a powerful example demonstrating how our core philosophy, the relentless pursuit of superior user experience, cost optimization and operational efficiency translates into sustainable market leadership.

8 | Faster growing and higher margin marketplace and marketing revenues will outpace product sales, driving further margin expansion over time.

Within this line, marketplace and marketing revenues were up 8.3%, primarily driven by higher growth in advertising revenues. Although growth moderated relatively to previous quarters against a high user traffic base, marketplace and marketing revenues consistently outpaced the product sales. We expect this structural divergence to continue, serving as an important driver for our margin expansion over time. Logistics and other service revenues increased by 5.9% year-on-year in the quarter. The pace normalized as our food delivery business lapped its initial launch and entered a full comparable year-on-year period starting this quarter.

9 | Improved profitability was primarily driven by JD Retail with lower OPEX, with optimized marketing spend, versus slightly higher R&D with respect to AI.

Turning to our consolidated profit performance. Group level gross margin expanded meaningfully by 120bps YoY to 17.1% in Q2, reaching a near all-time high. This expansion was primarily driven by JD Retail's remarkable margin performance. On operating expense, total operating expense decreased by 4.4% YoY in the quarter with the expense ratio decreasing by 0.3 percentage points. This operating leverage was largely driven by optimized marketing spend, which was partially offset by stepped-up R&D investments, particularly scalable AI applications. This leaner OpEx structure reflects our strategic focus on operational efficiency and bottom line quality over low ROI volume expansion.

10 | Saw good progress with  Joybuy in Europe and Jingxi.

Operations at our Joybuy and Jingxi businesses advanced steadily along their strategic path with strict ROI discipline. During the quarter, Joybuy sharpened its competitive edge in Europe through its fast, reliable fulfillment and premium localized services, such as integrated delivery and installation service for home appliances. By directly addressing local consumers' pain points, Joybuy is building increasing user retention and has doubled its revenues within 2 quarters. Jingxi continued to deepen its penetration in lower-tier markets with QAC increasing over 40% year-on-year and contributing 40% of new active customers in Q2, unlocking valuable incremental user pools for our ecosystem. While both businesses saw a sequential step-up in strategic investment, all spend was executed with rigorous discipline and strictly within our expectations.

11 | Joybuy now offers same-day and next-day delivery across major European cities, powered up by its own warehouse network in Europe.

First, Joybuy is starting to establish a clear edge in user experience and retention, powered by our own warehouse network in Europe. Joybuy now offers same-day and next-day delivery across major European cities, bringing 'place order in the morning, receive in the afternoon' hyperfast delivery services to over 40 million customers in Europe.

12 | JDL scaled thousands of unmanned ground features and launched their first 24 x 7 overnight autonomous delivery routes in Shenzhen.

On the logistics automation, our progress in physical logistics automation gives us substantial headroom to further optimize our cost structure and operating efficiency. In warehousing and sorting, JD through JD Logistics expanded deployment of our proprietary LangzuTech Goods-to-Person solution across more warehouses and product categories. In autonomous delivery, JDL scaled thousands of unmanned ground vehicles across more than 20 provinces as of Q2. We are launching our first 24/7 overnight autonomous delivery routes in Shenzhen. Powering this automation is our Jingdong Logistics MetaBrain LLM, which drives real-time intelligent decision-making within our exclusive automated operating framework.

13 | 2Q26 marks the clear inflection of its profitability, with margins to improve, and growth to reaccelerate in 2H26.

On JD Group's profitability, Q2 marked a clear inflection in its trajectory, returning to healthy year-on-year expansion. Looking ahead to the second half of the year, supported by core business health and investment discipline, we are confident in driving accelerated profit growth at the group level. Over the long term, as our core retail business has further room to enhance profitability and new businesses continue to optimize ROI efficiency, unlock synergies and gradually become new growth engines, we are well positioned to drive steady long-term profit expansion for the group.

➡️ Final Takeaways on https://t.co/A4MAdYIOYK $JD: 

While topline revenue growth was negative due to tougher comps in electronics and home applications, 3P, general merchandise, supermarket, advertising and logistics remained strong. Revenues should reaccelerate in H2 as tough comps ease. Food delivery continued to narrow losses and is moving in the right direction. Higher margin advertising, 3P, strong operating leverage should drive further profit margin expansion in the years ahead.

1 | 盈利能力出现转折点，并推动 JD Retail 健康的利润率扩张，同时 JD Food Delivery 亏损收窄。

最值得注意的是，第二季度标志着我们盈利轨迹的明确转折点。受 JD Retail 健康的利润率扩张和 JD Food Delivery 减亏的推动，我们归属于普通股股东的非公认会计准则净利润同比大增 21%，达到人民币 8.9 billion。特别是，JD Retail 的毛利率和经营利润率均创下促销旺季历史新高，JD Food Delivery 在该季度的亏损同比收窄超过 50%。这一表现凸显了我们商业模式的独特优势。

2 | 外卖在总亏损同比收窄 50% 的同时，保持了健康的订单量。

第二季度，JD Food Delivery 在保持健康订单量势头的同时，总亏损同比收窄超过 50%。在仅仅 1 年的执行时间里，JD Food Delivery 的单位经济效益实现了快速而显著的改善，这得益于我们坚持不懈地专注于提升运营效率和收入多元化。展望未来，我们认为外卖业务在进一步优化 UE 方面仍有巨大空间，同时我们将继续释放其与核心零售业务的跨板块协同效应。

3 | 由于电子产品和家用电器以旧换新计划的高基数对比，JD Retail 第二季度收入下降 -5%

其次，核心 JD Retail 在第二季度实现了有韧性的营收表现，同时继续释放盈利上行空间。进入第三季度，我们预计 JD Retail 将迎来转折点，重新加速实现营收正增长，同时保持健康的利润水平。

从品类表现来看，尽管电子产品和家用电器收入在第二季度受到高比较基数和上游价格上涨的影响而放缓，但势头在 6 月有所回升。

4 | 随着高基数对比压力缓解并正常化，预计第三季度增长将重新加速，同时保持健康的盈利能力。

展望下半年，尽管消费电子产品价格持续上涨可能会继续压制消费者需求，但我们仍有信心，出于三个原因，该品类的增长将在下半年显著改善：第一，基数效应开始逐步正常化。从第三季度开始，去年高交易基数带来的拖累将逐渐缓解。随着比较基数正常化，电子产品和家电的增长预计将重新加速。

5 | JD Retail 的 3P GMV 增长在过去连续 3 个季度持续快于 1P。预计 JD Retail 在下半年的增长将加速

我们继续引入高质量商家并孵化新兴品牌，同时帮助他们优化端到端运营。这使商家和品牌能够在 JD 上实现更确定的增长，同时也为我们的平台带来增量销售。JD Retail 的 3P GMV 增长在过去连续 3 个季度超过 1P，其对总 GMV 的贡献在第二季度环比扩大。因此总体而言，我们预计 JD Retail 的增长将在今年下半年逐季加速。我们的电子产品和家电应会稳步恢复，而日用百货品类保持健康增长。

6 | 在精细化运营和更高补贴效率的推动下，JD Food Delivery 的单位经济效益显著改善，每单补贴大幅下降。

JD Food Delivery 在第二季度取得了扎实进展，订单量保持健康增长，同时总亏损同比收窄超过 50%。因此，在仅仅 1 年的执行过程中，该业务的单位经济效益显著改善，这得益于精细化运营和更高的补贴效率。我们看到每单补贴同比明显下降，规模化下配送效率提升，以及佣金和广告收入贡献增加。

7 | 超市仍是一个关键亮点，实现了接近两位数的收入增长。

尤其是，我们的超市品类仍是一个关键亮点，实现了接近两位数的同比收入增长。凭借多年经验证的业绩记录，JD Supermarket 已确立其作为用户和供应商最值得信赖平台的地位。这一成功是一个有力例证，展示了我们的核心理念——不懈追求卓越用户体验、成本优化和运营效率——如何转化为可持续的市场领导地位。

8 | 增长更快、利润率更高的市场平台和营销收入将超过产品销售，推动利润率随时间进一步扩张。

在这一项下，市场平台和营销收入增长 8.3%，主要受广告收入更高增长推动。尽管在高用户流量基数下，增长相较前几个季度有所放缓，但市场平台和营销收入持续超过产品销售。我们预计这种结构性分化将继续，成为我们利润率随时间扩张的重要驱动力。本季度物流及其他服务收入同比增长 5.9%。随着我们的外卖业务已度过初始上线阶段，并从本季度开始进入完整的同比可比周期，增长节奏恢复正常。

9 | 盈利能力改善主要由 JD Retail 推动，其 OPEX 较低，营销支出得到优化，而与 AI 相关的研发支出略高。

转向我们的合并利润表现。集团层面的毛利率在第二季度同比显著扩大120个基点至17.1%，接近历史最高水平。这一扩张主要由 JD Retail 出色的利润率表现推动。在运营费用方面，本季度总运营费用同比下降4.4%，费用率下降0.3个百分点。这种经营杠杆主要由优化后的营销支出驱动，但部分被增加的研发投资所抵消，尤其是可扩展的 AI 应用。这种更精简的运营费用结构反映了我们在战略上专注于运营效率和利润质量，而非低 ROI 的规模扩张。

10 | Joybuy 在欧洲和 Jingxi 取得了良好进展。

我们的 Joybuy 和 Jingxi 业务在严格的 ROI 纪律下，沿着各自的战略路径稳步推进。本季度，Joybuy 通过快速、可靠的履约和优质本地化服务，在欧洲强化了竞争优势，例如为家电提供一体化配送和安装服务。通过直接解决当地消费者的痛点，Joybuy 正在提升用户留存，并在2个季度内实现收入翻倍。Jingxi 继续深化在低线市场的渗透，QAC 同比增长超过40%，并在第二季度贡献了40%的新活跃客户，为我们的生态系统释放了有价值的增量用户池。尽管这两项业务的战略投资均环比增加，但所有支出都以严格纪律执行，并严格符合我们的预期。

11 | Joybuy 现在依托其在欧洲自有的仓储网络，在欧洲主要城市提供当日达和次日达服务。

首先，依托我们在欧洲自有的仓储网络，Joybuy 正在用户体验和留存方面建立明确优势。Joybuy 现在在欧洲主要城市提供当日达和次日达服务，为欧洲超过4000万客户带来“上午下单，下午收到”的超快速配送服务。

12 | JDL 扩展了数千个无人地面设备，并在深圳推出了首批24 x 7夜间自动驾驶配送路线。

在物流自动化方面，我们在实体物流自动化方面的进展为我们进一步优化成本结构和运营效率提供了巨大空间。在仓储和分拣方面，JD 通过 JD Logistics 将我们自有的 LangzuTech Goods-to-Person 解决方案扩展部署到更多仓库和产品类别。在自动驾驶配送方面，截至第二季度，JDL 已在20多个省份部署了数千辆无人地面车辆。我们正在深圳推出首批24/7夜间自动驾驶配送路线。为这一自动化提供动力的是我们的 Jingdong Logistics MetaBrain LLM，它在我们专属的自动化运营框架内推动实时智能决策。

13 | 2Q26 标志着其盈利能力出现明确拐点，利润率将改善，增长将在2H26重新加速。

关于 JD Group 的盈利能力，Q2 标志着其发展轨迹出现明确拐点，恢复到健康的同比扩张。展望今年下半年，在核心业务健康和投资纪律的支持下，我们有信心推动集团层面的利润增长加速。长期来看，随着我们的核心零售业务仍有进一步提升盈利能力的空间，新业务持续优化 ROI 效率、释放协同效应并逐步成为新的增长引擎，我们处于有利位置，能够推动集团利润实现稳定的长期扩张。

➡️ 关于 JD.com $JD 的最终要点：

尽管由于电子产品和家电应用的可比基数更高，营收增长为负，但 3P、日用百货、超市、广告和物流依然强劲。随着高可比基数压力缓解，H2 的营收应会重新加速。食品配送业务继续缩窄亏损，并正朝着正确方向发展。利润率更高的广告、3P 以及强劲的经营杠杆，应会推动未来几年利润率进一步扩张。
